---
title: "Confidence interval"
params:
  lang: en
---

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(exams)
library(mathml)
library(htmltools)
library(mistakes)

hook(s2, subscript(s^2, D))
hook(s_d, subscript(s, D))
hook(n, N)
hook(quant, subscript(t, "0.975"))
hook(d, mean(D))
hook(d0, subscript(D, 0L))

task <- "confint4"
plfile <- file.path("rexams", sprintf("%s.pl", task))
rolog::consult(system.file(plfile, package="mistakes"))

source("utility.R")

## DATA GENERATION
repeat
{
  n <- as.integer(round(runif(1, min=25, max=50)))
  d0 <- round(runif(1, 9, 13)) 
  d <- d0 + round(runif(1, 0.5, 2),1) 
  s_d <- round(runif(1, 4, 8),1)
  s2 <- s_d^2

  quant <- round(qt(0.975, n - 1), 2)

  Q <- quote(search(confint4, confint4(n, d, d0, quant, s_d), .S, .R, .P, .E))
  S <- findall(Q, options=list(preproc=as.rolog), env=environment())

  if(problems(S))
    next

  break
}

t <- prepare(task=task, S)
sol <- format_feedback(t$correct, t$explanations, t$bugs, t$praise, t$blame, t$extra)
```

Question
========
A sample of $N=`r n`$ hospital nurses took part in an experimental program 
designed to reduce burnout. The burnout was assessed before and after 
using the Emotional Exhaustion subscale of the Maslach Burnout Inventory (MBI). 
The program is intended to yield a reduction of $D_0=`r d0`$ points on the MBI scale.

The mean reduction was $\overline{D}=`r d`$, this reduction varied with a variance of ${s_D}^2=`r s2`$.

Assuming that the difference scores are normally distributed, 
calculate the $95\%$ confidence interval for the mean reduction in burnout. 

The 97.5th percentile of the $t$-distribution with $`r n - 1`$ degrees of freedom is $`r quant`$.

```{r questionlist, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
answerlist(t$alternatives, markup="markdown")
```

Solution
========
The two-sided $95\%$ confidence interval is calculated by: `r t$solution`

```{r solutionlist, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
sol <- lapply(sol, FUN=gsub, pattern="\\n", replacement="")
answerlist(sol, markup="markdown")
```
